query:
SELECT
            COALESCE(g.issued_by, (
                SELECT i.created_by FROM invoice_items item
                JOIN invoices i ON i.id = item.invoice_id
                WHERE item.gift_card_id = g.id AND item.kind = 'gift_card'
                ORDER BY item.id LIMIT 1
            )) AS "issued_by?",
            NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoice_items WHERE gift_card_id=g.id AND kind='gift_card') AS "vat_review_required!",
            g.id,
            g.code,
            g.initial_amount::float8 AS "initial_amount!",
            g.balance::float8 AS "balance!",
            g.customer_id,
            c.name AS "customer_name?",
            g.bought_for,
            g.recipient_phone,
            delivery.state AS "delivery_status?",
            delivery.last_error AS "delivery_error?",
            g.expires_on,
            g.is_active
        FROM gift_cards g
        LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = g.customer_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT state, last_error FROM gift_card_deliveries
            WHERE gift_card_id = g.id ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
        ) delivery ON TRUE
        WHERE g.code = $1
